title: Localization assembly for the Koszul comparison
statement: Let L : C ⥤ D be a functor, W a morphism property and P an object property. Suppose P.ι ⋙ L localizes at the inverse image of W. For functors F,G : D ⥤ E, a natural transformation η : F ⟶ G whose component at every L(X) with P(X) is invertible is the hom of a natural isomorphism. For a further H : D ⥤ E and units uF : H ⟶ F and uG : H ⟶ G, equality uF ≫ e.hom = uG may be checked on these objects.

proof.text: Precomposition with the localization P.ι ⋙ L is fully faithful by Mathlib Localization.full_whiskeringLeft and faithful_whiskeringLeft. The restricted transformation is an isomorphism by NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app. Reflection of isomorphisms by fully faithful functors makes η an isomorphism. The second assertion follows by Localization.natTrans_ext applied to uF ≫ e.hom and uG, then evaluating the resulting equality.

lean.statement: theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.localizationNatTransIso {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E] (P : ObjectProperty C) (L : C ⥤ D) (W : MorphismProperty C) [(P.ι ⋙ L).IsLocalization (W.inverseImage P.ι)] (F G : D ⥤ E) (η : F ⟶ G) (hη : ∀ X : P.FullSubcategory, IsIso (η.app (L.obj X.obj))) : ∃ e : F ≅ G, e.hom = η
